publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: A new color video watermarking algorithm is proposed in this paper. Digital contents of digital videos are affected due to illegal reproduction and invalid redistribution of digital media. In literature, several approaches have been proposed to resolve this problem; embedding digital watermark is one among them. However, the effectiveness of the watermarks themselves is affected by various types of attacks. Proposed algorithm is based on DWT transforms. The LSB method is used to hide the data in the least significant bit of the “Original video” pixels. Imperceptibility, embedding capacity and robustness are the parameters for this technique. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm achieves these parameters in their acceptable range i.e. imperceptibility is high, embedding capacity is also high in noisy environment and highly robust to a wide range of attacks, e.g. salt & pepper noise, rotation, cropping & median filtering as compared to existing watermarking methods.

articleTitle: Asymmetrical parallel slotted multiband microstrip patch antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: A compact asymmetrical parallel slotted multiband microstrip patch antenna is proposed for Bluetooth and C band (4-8 GHz) applications. The proposed antenna is designed to operate at 2.4 GHz, 5.5 GHz, 7.2 GHz and 8 GHz. The proposed antenna is fed by 50 Ω microstrip feed line and fabricated on a low cost FR-4 substrate having dimensions 40 mm (L) × 40 mm (W) × 1.6 mm (h) with relative permittivity ε<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> =4.4 and loss tangent δ = 0.025. The proposed antenna is designed by etching three asymmetrical slots on a rectangular patch. Simulation is performed using CST microwave studio suite software. VSWR, reflection co-efficient and radiation pattern of the antenna are discussed in this paper. The proposed antenna can be used for Bluetooth application for IEEE 802.15.1 (operating in 2.402-2.480 GHz band), wireless local area network (WLAN) for IEEE 802.11 a (operating in the 5.15-5.828 GHz band), Defence and major commercial television broadcasters.

articleTitle: Performance of cooperative massive MIMO 5g cellular system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper, Massive MIMO technology is proposed to 5G cellular system which improves throughput and spectral efficiency. The system performance based on LTE system. Cooperative Massive MIMO system contains multiple base station antennas for multiple users. Cooperative Massive MIMO improved the system performance of Cell edge users by using Matched Filter (MF) Pre-coding. For 5G system Massive MIMO uses a large number of antennas with an order for magnitude more antennas than current LTE systems. MF (matched filter) Pre-coding is used at the eNodeBs to reduce inter user interference by using asymptotical Orthogonality among users. Cooperative Massive MIMO is used to eliminate to inter cell interference, pilot Contamination by using large number of base station antennas used.

articleTitle: RFID basedlab inventory management system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This study is an attempt to establish a model which is capable to monitor and manage all the inventories present in college laboratory, with the help of Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology. This model helps the lab assistant to keep a record and monitor all the inventories. At the same time it also helps students to search and check the availability of equipment and other articles. The complete inventory data is stored in a PC and made available through a graphical user interface (GUI) through which inventories can be added, searched, issued, returned and the history of any particular inventory or a student can be seen. This model also secure inventories from theft and thus proves out to be a more efficient and reliable system.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of anti-windup controller for non-linear magnetic levitation system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper, a new way is proposed to show the error windup phenomenon during actuator failure through experiment. The set-point tracking of ball position for Magnetic Levitation System with anti-windup PID controller is experimentally performed. When only PD controller is used for positioning of ball, steady-state error is present in the system. For reducing the steady-state error, integrator is added with PD controller. The integrator present in the system accumulates error during actuator saturation, an undesirable phenomenon known as integral windup occurs. To overcome integral windup, anti-windup technique (conditional integration) with PID controller is used. Experimental result shows that by using anti-windup with PID controller gives better set-point tracking and steady-state error is also minimized.

articleTitle: Design of CMOS difference amplifier circuit for sigma delta ADC for aerospace applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Since its inception, MOSFET has found its usage in almost every field. Researchers are consistently trying to shape circuits using CMOS technology which allows consumption of ultra low power instead of high power which was drawn earlier. In the present paper a design of CMOS Difference amplifier circuit which is an integral part of sigma delta ADC has been carried out. The sigma delta amplifier has been used in the design of ultra low power CMOS temperature sensor for aerospace applications. The difference between two inputs results into output in difference amplifier. The high gain operational amplifier plays a key role to design difference amplifier. Hence, an operational amplifier has also been proposed which gives an open loop gain of 48.45dB. The circuits are designed using cadence virtuoso UMC90nm CMOS technology. For the proper operation of the circuit, a power supply of + 1.3V to -1.3 V is used.

articleTitle: Cooperation of multi-robots for obstacle avoidance in clutter environment using differential evolutionary algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This paper deliberates an optimal navigation path for multiple mobile robots using the differential evolution (DE) algorithm. The algorithm determines the next position of every robots by considering the goal position and nearest obstacles coordinates. DE algorithm uses different popular vectors for balancing the exploration and exploitations to provide a nearly optimal solution. To get an optimized path from starting position of the robot to a target position, a sequence of the intermediate positions are taken into consideration through the algorithm. In each position, the robot predicts the position of obstacles before determining the next position. The simulation result unveils that, the proposed algorithm generates a safe, optimised and smooth path in an unknown environment.

articleTitle: Design & optimization of switched capacitor array based differential CMOS LC VCO for wide band application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This paper presents the design of Switched Capacitor Array (SCA) based low voltage and low phase noise differential Voltage Controlled Oscillator (VCO). Based on TSMC 0.18μm CMOS technology, schematic of the circuit with CADENCE environment has been designed. A sizing method is proposed to meet the requirement of Wi-Fi and Bluetooth standards. Circuit topology is a differential PMOS-NMOS core cross coupled LC-tank VCO. The simulation results manifested that the proposed VCO exhibits wide tuning range up to maximum frequency of 6.1GHz and phase noise performance of 113.4 dBc/Hz at 1MHz offset frequency has been accomplished. The power consumption of the design is 12.2 mW.

articleTitle: A hybrid approach for intelligent communication and performance analysis over DSRC VANET
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Secure communication between vehicle and Infrastructure/Road side unit(V to I/R) over Vehicular ad hoc network using Wi-Fi IEEE 802.11p standard and identifying accurate attacker vehicle is a major challenge over VANET in modern age. In this paper, implementing three encryption techniques i.e. DES, AES and RSA algorithm and comparison their performance with proposed method based on the analysis of its stimulation time at the time of encryption and decryption process, throughput and also its buffer size experimentally. Implementing of boundary with multiple RSU has been simulated using MATLAB software. In this work, a hybrid technique for authentication of a vehicle and road side unit (RSU) is proposed. Such environment can be used while designing better broadcasting schemes, security features in VANETs. The significance that MATLAB provide widely available, continuously updated and has wider reach. By assigning trust levels to every node the malicious nodes or misbehaving nodes are removed from the network.

articleTitle: Cloud based 3D printer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Melded Deposition Modeling (MDM) is an Additive Manufacturing Technology for printing 3D objects layer by layer. The main purpose of the research is to develop a low cost 3D Printer using simply accessible materials and conventional methods for manufacture which can be used to print objects restricted within 20cm× 20cm × 25cm printing Area. Many Industries uses conventional methods for developing prototype for analysis rather than using technologies like 3D printing because it is costly. After thorough market survey, we came to a conclusion that 3D Printers available in the Indian market are priced around Rs.1, 50,000 to 4,00,000 due to type of supporting material used. Initially we designed our 3D Printer entirely in 3D Modeling Software SOLIDWORKS and analyzed each part and selected readily offered material appropriately so as to develop a cost effective printer. Main objective of research is to develop a printer which is cost effective and to encourage manufacturers to adopt the method of 3D Printing. We also added many features in this 3d printer like cloud support, auto bed leveling, all filament support, hot end cooling fan for accurate printing.

articleTitle: A new leakage-tolerant domino circuit for wide fan-in gates with CNTFET
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper, a new leakage-tolerant domino circuit is presented which has lower power consumption and higher noise immunity without significant delay increment for wide fan-in gates. In the proposed technique, the voltage swing of the dynamic node can be reduced to decrease the power consumption caused by the heavy switching capacitance in wide fan-in gates. The simulation is provided with 64-input wide OR gates using a 32 nm CNTFET technology model. The simulation results are compared with CMOS of standard domino circuits at the same delay, and 98.4% power consumption reduction and 6.8 × Noise-immunity improvement are observed.

articleTitle: Design of microstrip patch antennas using method of moment based MATLAB codes
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This research paper presents the design of microstrip patch antenna through the simulation done by MATLAB source codes, which were developed using method of moment. In order to design, a simplest geometry of the patch antenna is chosen. Antennas of different length, width and feed locations are simulated. Antennas have been analyzed with various performance parameters such as impedance, radiation pattern, reflection coefficient, directivity and VSWR obtained. In order to validate the design approach, MATLAB simulation results for four antennas have been compared with the results obtained from electromagnetic CST simulator. Also one of the antennas has been fabricated in the laboratory and experimentally measured.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of combination of CS with PCA and LDA for face recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Feature selection is one of the most vital processes to achieve maximum accuracy in the face recognition system which helps in selecting the important and relevant information. In this paper, Cuckoo Search algorithm is used for further selection of optimized set of features out of the features extracted using DCT (Discrete Cosine Transform) — PCA (Principal Component Analysis) (DCT-PCA+CS) and LDA (Linear Discriminate Analysis) (LDA+CS) methods. On comparison with LDA and PCA alone, it has been observed that the proposed work not only produces good recognition rate with the original face images but also with image even after these are motion blurred.

articleTitle: Optimum values of TMS and ps of overcurrent relays using amalgam of GA-NLP methods
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Overcurrent relays ha an enormous advantage that its time of operation can be reduced as well as its coordination can be sustained with selection of optimum values of time multiplier setting (TMS) and plug setting (PS) of OCRs. This paper presents amalgam of genetic algorithm (GA) - nonlinear programming (NLP) methods for determining optimum values of TMS and PS of overcurrent relays. Genetic algorithm (GA) has a shortcoming of converging to those values which may not be optimum, and nonlinear programming (NLP) methods have shortcoming of converging to local optimum values, in case if the initial choice is nearer to local optimum. This paper proposes amalgam method to overcome the drawback of GA and NLP method, thereby determining the optimum settings of overcurrent relays. The main crux of this paper is to formulate problem of determining optimum values of TMS and PS of overcurrent relays in distribution systems as a nonlinear optimization problem as well as to determining initial values of TMS and PS using GA technique and to find optimum values using NLP method, thus making both the methods advantageous.

articleTitle: Solar assisted advance smart home automation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This paper proposes design and implementation of smart home automation using solar power. Solar Power has been interfaced with microcontroller and other house hold appliances. All these appliances can be controlled by the user with only one tap on mobile phone and wastage of energy can be curbed. Hence, an intelligent and smart control unit has been built with low energy consumption. The novelty of this work is development of a password oriented and a solar assisted smart home automation system. PROTEUS software has been used for simulation. The proposed technique has been implemented on hardware model and tested to control the loads with a wireless telephone.

articleTitle: Study of 6MW wind farm with and without STATCOM using MATLAB/SIMULINK
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Voltage Stability could be a key challenge for the stable operation of grid connected wind farm through-out the faults and grid interruptions. When the wind farm is directly connected to grid, the voltage stability is that the main issue for squirrel cage induction generator (SCIG) because of intermittent nature of wind velocity. Voltage stability drawback is sorted out with the help of flexible AC transmission system (FACTS) devices like static synchronous compensator (STATCOM). A STATCOM is used to counter problems like transient stability support in network including Squirrel Cage wind generator. The wind power system model is implemented using SIMULINK. The STATCOM results are better than static var compensator (SVC) for the stable operation of SCIG. STATCOM improves the stability problem and so help the wind generator system to remain in service throughout grid faults.

articleTitle: Reduced order modelling of ltisystems using invasive weed optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Reduction of single-input single-output (SISO) continuous time systems into reduced order model (ROM) using invasive weed optimization (IWO) has been presented here. IWO is a novel population based numerical stochastic, derivative free optimization algorithm inspired from the biological growth of weed plants. The objective function is the integral square error (ISE), which has been minimized. The step and frequency responses of both low and high order systems have been compared. Also, the performance of IWO has also been compared with other existing techniques in terms of ISE and transient response parameters. It has been observed that IWO outperforms the existing techniques in literature by giving low value of ISE and better transient response's parameters.

articleTitle: Enhancing e-governance using data mining tools and techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: With the influx of digital India movement, our country is equipped with strong digital infrastructure. In today's scenario, Government provide services to common people at their doorsteps through e-governance. Efficiency of government services can be enhanced through the use of ICT. The delegation of e-governance projects is channelized from central to state level and then to Gram Panchayats. Funds disbursed and the fund utilized for different projects are present in digital format at every level. After deploying the projects, there is a need to analyze the data stored at various levels. The effectiveness of government projects can be analyzed by applying various data mining tools and techniques. Data mining helps to extract hidden patterns from large pool of data. The aim of this research is to analyze the e-Governance data to measure the efficiency of different government schemes. Data mining techniques are used to analyze the data acquired from MNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National rural employment guarantee act) and SBM (Swachh Bharat Mission) projects. The proposed approach of data mining can be helpful for the government to further analyze other public beneficiary schemes.

Author Keywords: KDD-Knowledge discovery from databases MNREGA-Mahatma Gandhi National rural employment guarantee act

articleTitle: A low phase noise VCO using injection locking
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper a general design of a low phase noise and wide tuning range injection-locked (IL) LC-voltage control oscillator (VCO) has been proposed. The circuit simulation is done by Cadence Virtuoso Analog Design Environment using SCL 180nm CMOS process. The simulated results show that tuning range of the VCO which ranges from 22.2 to 83.5 MHz which corresponds to 115.9% tuning range for control voltage ranged from 0 to 1.1 V. The simulated output phase noise at o Eiset frequency of 1 MHz is −162 dBc/Hz. The power consumption of the VCO is 12.2 μW at 1.8 V supply voltage.

articleTitle: A cloud data access control and lockbox approach for data sharing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Cloud computing and its security with users multilabel data is provided security by different module by different author. The security in terms which provided either encryption or in terms of hashing which aims to provide integrity verification. In this paper our work determine a LockBox technique which aims to provide a highly secure mechanism for data sharing and its authenticity maintain. This technique leads in data processing using data hiding and key sharing among the given selected user. The simulation is performed with CPU 4 GB RAM, 1 TB Hard disk and Windows 10 platform with Apache Server. The results were monitored in terms of computation time at server end and also security measures which claims the high level of security provided in the proposed work. Our work is deems to be an innovative work with cloud security and its architecture.

articleTitle: Speed control of electric vehicle using fuzzy logic controller
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper, the utilization of regenerative braking energy to control the speed of electric vehicle based on fuzzy logic controller is discussed. A fuzzy logic controller established is sugeno type. The output of motor controller of electric vehicle with fuzzy logic controller is acting as feedback to motor and improvement in speed of vehicle is observed. Under condition of stability and braking safety, the proposed strategy includes two types of braking force, one is regenerative and another one is frictional. So that a large amount of kinetic energy can be converted into electrical energy form and this electrical energy can be stored in the storage device like battery. This strategy is used to use the motor's regenerative braking characteristics. Modeling of FLC (fuzzy logic controller) is done under the MATLAB/Simulink software. Simulation was done with different cycles and FLC is examined with SOC (state of charge) of a battery, speed of motor and required force to drive vehicle.

articleTitle: An ultra large polarisation independent bandstop frequency selective surface for the security of WiMax and WLAN application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: The important parameter of the wireless devices is its security from unwanted signals or unlicensed bands. As the interference from undesired signals not only degrade the system performance but also hinders the security. In this work, a novel single layer FSS has proposed that operates as bandstop filter at 1.8GH, 3.5GHz and 5.5GHz. The proposed design consists of three elements by virtue of which the FSS Resonates at 1.8GHz, 3.5GHz, 5.5GHz. The dimension of superstrate is 0.24λ × 0.24λ and dielectric constant of 4.4mm with thickness 1.6mm and tangential loss 0.025. Surface current and various incident angle distribution has illustrated to show much clear resonance behavior of FSS. The proposed structure holds great angular independence as the structure is symmetrical in both TE (Transverse Electric) and TM (Transverse Magnetic) field. The CST MW simulation software is used for designing and simulation of the results. A good reflection curves are observed at 1.8GHz, 3.5GHz, and 5.5GHz.

articleTitle: Nano-cavity coupled waveguide photonic crystal based biosensor detection of cervical cancer using nucleus and cytoplasm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: A biosensor is a device used by binding mechanism to detect the analytes or particle of a sample. A two-dimensional photonic crystal linear waveguide based biosensor is designed with a nano cavity. The sensing mechanism is depending on change in refractive index of the analytes, leading to a shift in the transmission. In this paper, a two-dimensional photonic crystal nano cavity based biosensor is proposed and designed to detect the cervical cancer through cytoplasm and nucleus in the cell. The bandgap calculation is done by Plane wave expansion method (PWE) which is determine the band gap in photonic crystal structure which provides the information related to the wavelength. The band gap of proposed biosensor is 1909 nm to 1302 nm, and input wavelength of 1550nm. The simulation results have analyzed by using the finite difference time domain (FDTD) method.

articleTitle: Improvement of energy efficiency using pdorp protocol in WSN
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks are battery driven and there is limited battery lifetime. It is not possible to change battery of WSN, as sometimes the nodes are deployed in regions, where it is difficult to reach frequently. Some of the energy efficient routing protocols of WSN are discussed. But energy consumption can be reduced by decreasing packet overhead caused by updating routing table frequently. PEGASIS (Power Efficient Gathering in Sensor Information System) protocol which is somewhat energy efficient is combined with DSR(Dynamic Source Routing), which uses GA and BFO to find the optimal path.

articleTitle: Economic comparison of solar PV and diesel water pumping system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In today's scenario feasibility of a system is of utmost importance to install it and get the desired output in a more economic and better way. In this study investigation has been done about the feasibility check of solar powered irrigation practice followed in Pipalda Kalan a village in Rajasthan near Kota. To run a submersible pump and supply water to crop a photovoltaic based pump is used to utilize solar energy as the basic source of it. Moreover, same rating pumps of 5 hp of solar as well as diesel have been considered for the economic analysis. Various parameters like benefit cost ratio, net present worth and internal rate of return are considered for the economic analysis and comparison of the two system. The comparison shows that the solar water pumping system was more feasible than the diesel-operated pump.

articleTitle: Dynamic phasor model of wams enabled transient stability controller
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This paper presents the dynamic phasor model of WAMS enabled transient stability controller. In general, when any disturbance is occurs in power system than it contains low frequency oscillations which have to damp quickly for system stability. Primary controls are not able to damp these oscillations. Secondary control with synchronized phasor measurement obtained through PMU as feedback is good choice for damping of such oscillations. Also, Dynamic phasor model of the system can directly take data from PMU and also linearized the system which makes tuning of the controller parameters easy. Due to this reason, dynamic phasor model of secondary controller with PMU data as feedback is present in this paper.

articleTitle: Automated medical image segmentation using RBF ANN
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Medical imaging is the technique and process of creating visual representations of the interior of a body for clinical analysis and medical intervention, as well as visual representation of the function of some organs or tissues. The Segmentation of medical image is essential and first step in medical image processing. The choice of a segmentation method depends on several considerations, namely the nature of the image and the primitives to extract etc. We propose Artificial neural network for the choice of the segmentation method. First, an evaluation of the quality of segmentation by different methods and using various statistical evaluations was carried out. Then, a characterization of images, based on some objective parameters, was performed. The resulting descriptors will be used as input to the Artificial neural network to associate each type of image with the adequate segmentation method after learning. The proposed segmentation methods and neural approach has helped to improve accuracy.

articleTitle: A novel approach for multiple DG allocation in distribution system of jaipur city
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: A novel approach has been proposed in this paper to find out optimal position of DG units in radial distribution system. An objective function is formulated to find out the optimal size, quantity and position of DG units for real power loss reduction and voltage profile enhancement. A new mathematical expression, Power Voltage Sensitivity Constant (PVSC), has been proposed to solve the allocation problem. The total size of DG units is also restricted up to 50% of total load of system. The results of the proposed technique are validated on standard IEEE 33 bus system and 130 bus real distribution system of Jamawaramgarh, Jaipur city. The obtained results are compared with latest optimization techniques to show the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: An alleviated model for private cloud deployment using VMware
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Computers have become an inevitable part of our life. As we do more computing tasks, more resources are required. A traditional computer, though fulfilling our needs has a limited scope of resources. What if we need instant, unlimited and ubiquitous resources? The solution is Cloud Computing. In this paper, I propose a novel approach to deploy a private cloud to adapt to an Organization or Institute who do not want to spend much on computing. In addition, I alleviate the components of the deployment model and integrate the model with OpenFiler to provide scalable storage. This private cloud will provide low-cost and easy management solution. The implementation is done using various VMware products which are discussed later in this paper.

articleTitle: Adaptive pitch control design for variable speed wind turbine using chebyshev neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This paper presents an adaptive pitch control designed for a variable speed wind turbine (VSWT). Due to nonlinear and uncertain dynamics of VSWT, the conventional controllers show unsatisfactory performance under irregularity of wind speed. The pitch control design problem in the VSWT system is very challenging if the dynamics of the system are unknown. The unknown dynamics of the VSWT has been approximated with the help of Chebyshev neural network (CNN) for the proposed control design. The weight adaptation law for the tuning of CNN is derived using Lyapunov theory. Simulation results demonstrate satisfactory performance of the proposed adaptive pitch control design scheme.

articleTitle: Proportional learning rate model reference adaptive control for fast adaptation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Since adaptive controllers does not excessively depend on dynamical system models therefore, it has been used for several applications. But achieving fast adaptation using high gain learning rate is a limitation of adaptive controller. As high gain learning rate causes bursting and oscillations in the control signal which leads the system to instability and false adaptation. In this paper to address this problem of fast adaptation a novel proportional learning rate adaptive controller based on non-quadratic Lyapunov function is proposed. Effectiveness of the proposed work is demonstrated with simulation results of a numerical example.

articleTitle: Content delivery and management system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Delivery of set of message as content from one node points to different connected nodes of a network system may show different types of result during delivering period. When a message is send from a central nodes to different nodes, then the message may be fully delivered, partially delivered or not delivered. During partial delivering of message there is no specific rule how much volume of message is delivered. So, study of fuzzy mathematics exists during partial delivered of message as there exist some comparable study of partial delivered of message. From the fuzzy set theory of view point, if message is fully delivered it is assigned a value 1; if it is not delivered it is assigned a value 0 and if it is partially delivered then values is assigned with value in open interval (0, 1). In this paper it is tried to study delivery of message with respect to fuzzy theory. It is also tried to study that different factors like Time, distance and Network's combination can be used to manage during delivery of message. In this paper, it is tried to study the cases of delivery of message by using technical approach of fuzzy mathematics that can be applied to a content distribution network.

articleTitle: Designing of 2×1 antenna with improved isolation using meander line structure
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper we proposed optimum length of an antenna with improved microstrip patch design employed with meander line structure with intended application of WLAN band operating at 2.42 GHz. The Meander antenna is the advanced version of the basic folded antenna and having higher radiating efficiency than the previous one. This antenna structure is electrically small. The compactness of a meander antenna array is affected by the mutual coupling between radiation elements, which degrades the array performances in terms of isolation capability, return loss, radiation efficiency, and impedance match. A two-port compact microstrip antenna array, with stepped ground structure is presented here to improve the isolation. This antenna is constructed using FR4 substrate. After simulation with CST software the performance of the proposed designed antenna is investigated and compared with both the structures. An improvement of 1.69dB in coupling loss (S21) and 3.88dB in return loss (S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>)are achieved.

articleTitle: An approach to analyze the impact of DDOS attack on mobile cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Mobile ad-hoc network is form of wireless networks recognized with the purpose of provisional communication with no additional infrastructure. Open nature communication make is prone for several security threats such as resource draining attacks or routing exhaustion. Security is the major concern to maintain the trust on communication or network concert. Cloud computing is broad and diverse technology. Clients are allowed to share their resource and infrastructure as service with no major hurdles. It helps to store large amount of data and make remote transactions with public or private network infrastructure. Cloud computing using MANET is different joint venture of new era help to establish resource sharing with ad-hoc nature. Authors investigate that illegal access and damage of resources pathetic and can damage equivalent as illegal access to data. Study also observes that resource draining is completely independent process and doesn't lie on vulnerabilities of routing protocols. Denial of Service attack and Distributed Denial of Service attack is kind of resource draining purposely deployed to degrade the performance by exhausting the resource. This paper aims to make survey of all issues relates this security concern on MANET and Cloud computing.

articleTitle: Minimum area layout of high bandwidth folded cascode operational amplifier using SCL 180nm CMOS technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This paper presents the design and layout of a high speed folded cascode operational amplifier with the minimum layout area in SCL 180nm CMOS technology. The analog circuits are more vulnerable to parasitic due to its inherently large W/L. In order to accomplish the desired performance, parasitic issues must be clearly handled. The layout of the Opamp is done with the standard method; larger parasitic are generated in this layout, thus poor performance. To tackle the performance degradation due to parasitic, layout techniques such as multi-finger and common centroid layout are used which drastically improve the performance.

articleTitle: Metamaterial enhanced magnetization induced communication for wireless applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Electromagnetic (EM) waves are not useful for underground wireless communication, due to high path losses, changing channel condition and requirement of large size antennas. Magnetic Induction (MI) communication is an alternate technique with great potentials in RF-challenging environments, such as underground and underwater applications where propagation medium is rock and water but no longer air. Since the Magnetic fields attenuated very fast in the near field region, Metamaterial enhanced Magnetic Induction (M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>I) communication has been established. In this scheme MI coil antenna is encased by a metamaterial spherical shell that can amplify the magnetic fields around the MI transceivers. In this paper M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>I communication scheme is used and the comparison is done using different infilling material between coil antenna and a metamaterial spherical shell but same antenna size for fair comparison. The results showing that mutual inductance can be varied by varying the infilling and is improved. Also the antenna size is reduced so that the M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>I communication is established using small size coils.

articleTitle: Power quality monitoring of different brands of laptops
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: With the development in power electronics industry, electrical appliances have become more power electronic based. The power quality is affected by increased use of these nonlinear loads and increases harmonics in low voltage distribution system. Different brands of laptops such as Sony Vaio, HP, Lenovo are taken in this paper for power quality monitoring by using HIOKI PW3198 Power Quality Analyzer. Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) is calculated for individual laptop and then combined impact of these laptops on power quality are also seen. To compare the harmonics impact and analysis of power quality, different laptops reactive power, active power, apparent power and power factor also measured. Such experimental results help engineers to evaluate the harmonic that exists within a laptops and IT sector.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of switching techniques for three phase induction motor drive
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This paper describes various harmonic reduction techniques and their comparative analysis. In this paper, most basic techniques such as SPWM, Third Harmonic injection SHE are compared with each other. This kind of comparison is required because of growing power quality concern in modern power system and to improve efficiency of existing AC machine employed in any industry.

articleTitle: A result evaluation on anonymiser and active object based TTP location privacy framework
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: We propose a novel location-privacy preserving mechanism for TTP using hiding original location. To take advantage of the high effectiveness of hiding user queries from the server, which minimizes the exposed information about the users' location to the server; we propose a mechanism in which a user can hide in the mobile crowd while using the service. The rationale behind our scheme is that users who already have some location-specific information (originally given by the service provider) can pass it to other users who are seeking such information. They can do so in a wireless peer-to-peer manner. Simply put, information about a location can “remain” around the location it relates to and change hands several times before it expires. Our proposed collaborative scheme enables many users to get such location-specific information from each other without contacting the server, hence minimizing the disclosure of their location information to the adversary. Proposed system avoids the privacy problems of users by collaborate with each other to jointly improve their privacy, without the need for a trusted third-party. In effect, the mobile crowd acts as a TTP, and the protection mechanism becomes a distributed protocol among users. Desktop users concerned about their location privacy are indeed the most motivated to engage in protecting themselves.

articleTitle: Efficient time shared task scheduler for cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Many virtual clusters, virtual machines run in each data center hosting number of heterogeneous tasks submitted by different cloud customers. In this concept, scheduling of incoming tasks to cloud should be scheduled on to less number of physical servers which improves the resource utilization. Scheduler should also efficiently manage the load between resources and achieve minimum execution time. In this paper, we designed an efficient approach for time shared task scheduler which effectively does load balancing, resource utilization and provides high performance than existing time shared task scheduler. This algorithm has been tested using CloudSim toolkit and results were compared with existing time shared task scheduler.

articleTitle: Bandwidth optimization of an ultra-wide band microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Thispaper presents an Ultra-Wide Band (UWB) microstrip antenna designed by optimizing four antenna parameters. The antenna was etched on an FR4_epoxy substrate with relative permittivity of 4.4 and thickness of 1.6 mm. The design process starts with a conventional microstrip antenna which has a S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub><; -10 dB fractional bandwidth of 5%. The performance improvement methods are described presenting the resonant behavior at each development stage. The ground plane has been truncated and a slot has been placed on the patch. The size of the ground plane, position of the slot and size of the slot have been optimized. In the optimized design, a fractional bandwidth of 117% has been achieved. The UWB performance has been analyzed with the help of the S11 plot and the current patterns.

articleTitle: Routing protocol in hybrid wireless network which increases quality of service
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Wireless network are of two types, Base station (BS) oriented wireless network and Ad hoc wireless network. Base station oriented is single hop that requires fixed base station having better performance and more reliable, whereas Ad hoc wireless network does not have any centralized administration and mobile host are dependent on each other for communication. But when BS failure causes the problems in the network in base station oriented network and rerouting caused by mobility and disrupted connection causes the problems in ad hoc network. Therefore we use here the Hybrid Wireless Network (HWN), is basically a wireless network consisting of mobile nodes communicate with each other with or without any infrastructure support [2]. In HWN mobile nodes communicate with each other using ad hoc mode when they are in range and use BS to communicate when they are out of range. HWN is more efficient, reliable and flexible with seamless handover. wireless communication gains popularity, significant research has been devoted to supporting real-time transmission with stringent Quality of Service (QoS) requirements for wireless applications. A wireless hybrid network integrates a mobile wireless ad hoc network (MANET) and a wireless infrastructure network has been proven to be a better alternative for the next generation wireless networks.

articleTitle: Nonlinear PI with state feedback control for activated sludge process
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper, an attempt is made to find a centralized nonlinear PI controller with state feedback for the activated sludge process (ASP) used in wastewater treatment plants. The effluent substrate concertation and dissolved oxygen (DO) concentration is controlled irrespective of the variations in disturbance and system parameters. The theoretical framework in this paper is developed on the basis of Falb's row by row decoupling (RRDP) concept. The centralized controller is implemented in a ASP control simulation and the closed loop structure is observed to decouple the process variables better than previous linear controller reported.

articleTitle: Design of a new linear robust controller structure
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper, a new linear robust control structure for stable and unstable systems is proposed. The structure provides a better set-point tracking, disturbance rejection and guarantees zero steady state error. Moreover, the proposed structure consists of an integrator, a gain and a characteristics polynomial of the desired system. It requires minimum information to design the controller i.e. order of the system. Two simulation examples are discussed to demonstrate the effectiveness proposed control structure.

articleTitle: Reflectance and transmittance of silicon nanocone based solar cells at varying incidence angles
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Nanocone array based solar cells shows light trapping property that reduces the reflections and increase the antireflection property. In this paper, we proposed the effect of different tilt angles on reflectance and transmittance of Silicon nanostructure array obtained from simulation of nanocone based solar cells. Reflectance and transmittance has been observed in the visible spectrum for wavelength 0.5μm through simulation software OptiFDTD. It is necessary to take into account factors like position, location and sky path while positioning or installing a solar panel. The result are obtained for varying tilt angles 0°, 15°, 30°, 45° and 60° The silicon nanostructures has a square geometry which has a height of 1μm and diameter of 0.5μm. The refractive index of Si nanocones is taken as 3.85.

articleTitle: Low power high speed 1-bit full adder circuit design in DSM technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In today's high-speed communication world the usage of electronics portable devices is increasing day by day, as the devices are portable and compact it has to satisfy the need of low power dissipation and minimum area requirement along with the high speed. A one bit full adder cell is one of the most frequently used digital circuit component in arithmetic logic unit (ALU) and it is the essential functional unit of all computational circuit. Till now many improvement has been done in this area to refine the architecture and performance of full adder circuit design. This paper mainly focus on two novel 1-bit full adder cells which is designed on 32 nm CMOS technology with different operating frequencies at 1 v supply voltage. The design of two novel 1-bit full adder cells along with three existing adder cells are incorporate in this paper and their complete comparison and verification has been done in terms of power dissipation, delay and power delay product (PDP) at different operating frequencies by using HSPICE tool. It is found that the existing Static Energy Recovery Full (SERF) adder and Gate Diffusion Input (GDI) full adder provides poor performance when compared with proposed adder cell and also its equivalent layout has been generated to calculate the area of existing and proposed adder cell by using Microwind 3.5 tool. From the simulation result it is observed that the first proposed adder circuit using XOR module has achieved maximum saving of PDP 46.71% & 96.61% when compared to existing SERF and GDI adder cells respectively. The second proposed circuit using XNOR module has achieved maximum saving of PDP 74.59% & 98.38% when compared to existing SERF and GDI 1-bit adder cells respectively.

articleTitle: Rohrs benchmark problem revisited by adaptive control with closed loop reference model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper, a benchmark problem of adaptive control Rohrs example has been revisited with recently developed model reference adaptive control (MRAC) with closed-loop reference model (CRM). The paper incorporates an overview of CRM architecture with state feedback, which is appropriate for the control of such system. We also explore through qualitative considerations the fundamental difference between the conventional MRAC referred as open loop reference model ORM and CRM.

Author Keywords: adaptive control with closed loop reference model

articleTitle: Design of circularly polarized microstrip patch antennas for wireless communication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In the proposed research work, antennas with circular polarization has been designed with the help of IE3D electromagnetic simulator. Four different geometry has been chosen for this. In that, 2 similar slots have been etched diagonally on the square microstrip patch. Four slots like square, circular, ring and cross-shaped was selected in order to create and prove circular polarization behavior. Axial ratio (A.R.) performance plot reflects the required circular polarization characteristics. Antennas performance was characterized with respect to reflection coefficient, impedance plot and three dimensional patterns. One of the antennas was fabricated in the laboratory and experimentally measured in order to validate the procedure.

articleTitle: Scattered context grammar in hindi linguistics
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: The Hindi language is considered amongst the richest morphological language because of the various forms generated from a single word form. In this paper, dependencies among various words in Hindi sentences are entertained using scattered context grammar. This paper also includes the rules which are to be considered while converting nouns, adjectives and verbs from their singular form to plural form using Transducers and hence the application of scattered context grammar is explored in using nouns, adjectives and verbs in the sentences. This paper also covers a step higher of scattered context grammar which is transformational scattered context grammar.

articleTitle: Comparative study of interconnect network on chip topology in multicore processors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: A variety of technologies in recent years have been developed in designing on-chip networks with the multicore system. In this endeavor, network interfaces mainly differs in the way a network physically connects to a multicore system along with the data path. Semantic substances for interaction in a multicore system are transmitted as data packets. Thus whenever a communication is made from a network, data packet is first divided into sub-packets and then into non varying-length bits for flow control. To measure required space, energy & latency overheads for the implementation of various interconnection topologies we will be using multi2sim simulator tool that will act as research bed to experiment various trade offs between performance and power, and between performance and area requires analysis for further possible optimizations.

articleTitle: Reduced order model using modified cauer form for multi-input and multi-output LTI systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper, the modified Cauer form (MCF) discussed to reduce a high order system. This method is based on the continued fraction method. Reduced order model analysis is much easier as compared to original high order model. The coefficients of denominator and numerator of desired reduced order model are evaluated by inversion of modified Routh array. The modified Cauer form is used to reduce multi-input multioutput (MIMO) linear time invariant system. The proposed reduced order model is compared with other model order reduction techniques.

articleTitle: A study to increase 24 hour efficiency of distributed generation: Review
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Distributed generations are the need of the hour. With increase in greenhouse gases and depletion of fossil fuels, distributed generation using renewable non-conventional energy sources have gained much importance. Among these wind and solar have maximum explored due to their easy access. The most common setback of these distributed generation is there unpredictable nature. The solar energy is not available during night and wind energy can't be harvested above it cut off limit and below cut in limit. Hence when these non-convention, renewable distributed generation is not generating energy, the power electronics devices used in them remains idle. In this paper a detailed study of making use of these power electronic devices used in these distribution generation is reviewed. There are many researchers working on to these problem and came up with solutions to make 24 hour optimized usage of these power electronics devices in such a way that it compliments to grid stability and reactive power management.

articleTitle: Comparative study of UPFC installing at various location in multimachine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Low frequency electromechanical oscillation are prescribed features in power system and it tremendous affect on the line transfer capability and stability of the power system. power system oscillations can be damped by FACTS devices. Computer simulation studies performed on a multimachine test system are presented in this paper and comprehensive analysis and results are obtained for voltage profile at all buses, damping of oscillations in the power system during fault conditions with UPFC at various locations in the test system.

articleTitle: Social media data sensitivity and privacy scanning an experimental analysis with hadoop
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Now in these days the social network has becomes a daily habit for all. Most of the young and teenager are consuming their time on social media. Due to frequent reachability of users the different marketing companies are also usages this platform for publishing advertises. But not only legitimate users are available in this platform, sometimes this platform is also used for abusing someone or harshen someone. Therefore, it is need to identify the sensitive contents on the social media platforms before publishing the contents. A number of different kinds of approaches are available for scanning the contents, but all these techniques are much time-consuming. Therefore, these techniques are not directly used with the social networks. In order to find an efficient technique an effort is presented in this work. The proposed technique is an enhancement over the traditional finger print scan method for sensitive content evaluation. The proposed technique incorporates the NLP (natural language processing) parsers for identifying the sensitive features. The sensitive features are considered here as the noun words in any twit, because in most of the cases the identity of person or places are used for misguiding the social network users. Additionally, in place of linear search technique, a random index scan method is introduced for improving the time consumption of the traditional approaches. Because this technique produces the results equal as the linear search in worst case. The proposed technique is evaluated over the twitter data using the Hadoop, Strom and twitter API implementation. After the successfully implementation the technique is compared with the traditional available technique over the time and space complexity. The experimental results show the performance in terms of time requirement is three times efficient than the traditional approach of sensitivity scan.

articleTitle: A nano power voltage reference generator using of sub threshold MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: A Nano power CMOS voltage generator circuit has been implemented using a 0.18μm standard CMOS process technology. The circuit has MOSFETs operated in sub threshold region without resistor. It works on the concept of temperature compensation of threshold voltage. It generate 212mV output reference voltage in supply voltage range 0.8–1.8V. The temperature coefficient of voltage was 256ppm/°C in temperature range 0–150°C. The line sensitivity was 15%/V in the operating voltage range 0.8–1.8 V, and power supply rejection ratio (PSRR) was −42dB at 100 Hz and −35dB at 10 MHz.

articleTitle: Dynamic spectrum allocation for hybrid access cognitive femtocell network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: The cognitive femtocell is an inspiring technology that solves the indoor coverage problem in future cellular networks also Cognitive radio (CR) support dynamic spectrum access. In this paper, a new dynamic spectrum allocation method for hybrid access cognitive femtocell is proposed. In the proposed method, the macro base station (BS) allocates a portion of subchannels to the femto access point (FAP) to serve the macro users (MUs). Then, the FAP allocates the subchannels and power to maximize the femtocell network utility, whereas the throughput of the served MUs is guaranteed. Moreover, there is problem of resource allocation and we formulate that problem as sum utility maximization problem and we solve the problem by using dual decomposition method.

articleTitle: Frequency spectrum-based optimal design of power system stabilizer for primary frequency control
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Power system is a highly non-linear system. The nonlinearity of the system causes different output patterns around the different equilibrium point. Therefore for every transition from one equilibrium point to another equilibrium point, the behavior of system changes. The frequency, being the most critical parameter of the system, the drift from its equilibrium point due to various reasons like small and large disturbances, should be strictly damped out. The power system stabilizer (PSS), not only used for damping the angular velocity drift of the machine but also for frequency control. The feedback signal provided by PSS to the system is commonly the magnitude of drift of angular velocity of machine or drift of load angle. This paper presents a frequency spectrum (FS) based approach for PSS design. The methodology is supported by appropriate theoretical and simulation evidence. The theoretical aspect represents state space design of system and simulation is done for a single machine infinite bus system (SMIB) and well known IEEE New England 10 machine 39 bus system (NE 39 test system).

articleTitle: Enhanced bandwidth circularly polarized antenna array based on sequentially rotated feed technique for c-band
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This paper revealed the results on enhanced bandwidth antenna array designed to operate at a frequency of 6.8GHz. Single antenna used in this array is Circularly polarized square slot antenna (CPSSA). Each single antenna is made by using inverted L shape grounded strips located at slots opposite corner to reduce cross polarization. Symmetric coplanar waveguide feeding is used in this antenna. Here CPSSA performance has been enhanced in terms of impedance bandwidth and axial ratio bandwidth by using sequential rotated feed technique at the cost of reduced gain and directivity. Sequentially rotated feed technique are made by using 2×2 antenna array. This technique enhances the impedance bandwidth of 3.8 GHz in the range of 4.5 GHz to 8.3 GHz and it is also enhance 3 dB axial ratio bandwidth for VSWR <1.8.

Author Keywords: Left hand circular polarization (LHCP) and Right hand circular polarization (RHCP) etc

articleTitle: Split data green multihop cooperative communication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Now a day's Energy efficiency is the main issue in wireless communication. Currently multi is hoping cooperative communication very energy efficient scheme, where the relays operate on small batteries so that energy consumption must be minimized. The total energy consumption in relay networks includes the transmission energy, circuit's energy consumption and active time of circuits. In this paper, we analyze the split data packet scheme with multi hops cooperative communication to minimize the total energy consumption in wireless sensor networks. A split the data packets between relays it reduces the number of data packets at each relay it can be increased the lifetime and throughput of the relay.

articleTitle: Virtual machine schedulers for cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: To process the cloud services, data centers consume large amounts of electrical power which results in huge amount of carbondioxide emissions. Hence there is need for development of energy efficient management techniques. In this concept, scheduling of incoming tasks to cloud should be scheduled on to less number of physical servers which improves the resource utilization and reduces the power consumption. Scheduler should also efficientlymanage the load between resources and achieve minimum execution time. In this paper, weanalyzedvirtual machine scheduler space shared, virtual machine scheduler time shared and virtual machine scheduler time shared over subscription and tested them using CloudSim toolkit to examine their behavior. The results show virtual machine scheduler time shared effectively utilizes resources by sharing MIPS among virtual machines of a server and thus reduces number of powered on servers in a data center, which also reduces the power consumption than virtual machine scheduler space shared and virtual machine scheduler time shared over subscription approaches.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of leach based approaches for large area coverage in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are a collection of specially designed nodes to provide support to sensor information propagation. Sensor nodes are basically designed to sense data as sensor and distribute to servers for further analysis. Based on the specific requirements, the numbers of sensor nodes can range from hundreds to thousands. All the communication will take place through predefined network characteristics. WSNs generally face energy issues. LEACH is designed for efficient cluster formation. It provides an efficient energy solution for data transmission from node to base station. Various enhanced version of LEACH has been proposed by Assuming LEACH as base protocol. The energy constraints are a critical aspect in developing the routing protocols for WSNs. Designers and researchers have contributed their effort through enhancement in energy saving procedure into WSNs. In this work, the LEACH based protocols and their performance in WSN has been analysed. This research paper evaluates recent advancement in LEACH based approaches for Wireless Wide Area Sensor Network with comparison table.

articleTitle: Control system design for process with recycle
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This work focuses on synthesizing linear centralized controllers for a certain class of multivariable process with recycle. The multivariable process represented by a state-space model in the presence of dead time appear in both the outputs and the states, but not in the inputs. Falb's necessary and sufficient condition for decoupling is used to find the relative degree of the closed loop reference model. Then the centralized controller is found using Falb's row by row decoupling (RRDP) concept. The Static state feedback and Static state feedback with PI control law are tested with a MIMO benchmark system (two reactors in series with recycle). For the effectiveness of the control system, the effect of uncertainty in recycle flow rate for a increase of 20% and 50% is taken into consideration.

articleTitle: Diminution of harmonics in multilevel inverter using particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In recent years, various industrial applications have begun to require higher power apparatus. Medium voltage and megawatt power level are required by some medium voltage motor drives and utility applications. A multilevel converter not only achieves high power ratings, but also it makes possible the use of renewable energy sources. For a high power application, renewable energy sources such as wind, photovoltaic and fuel cells can be simply interfaced to a Multi-level converter system. The cascaded multilevel inverter has received special attention due to its modularity and simplicity of control among the different topologies for multilevel converters. As current work is mainly focused on the Cascaded H bridge topology of multilevel inverter, and the main objective of this paper to mitigate harmonics in the output of multilevel inverters using optimal selection of firing angles for five level cascaded H bridge multilevel inverters using linearly decreasing inertia weight particle swarm optimization technique.

articleTitle: Analysis of 2T 1D memory cell with various active capacitors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper two transistor DRAM cell forms with one diode have been designed and analyzed. Insertion of diode in the memory cell fulfils the requirements of a capacitor to get improvisation in memory read and write operation. Both nmos and pmos transistors are used to implement two types of storage capacitors i.e. gate and junction. Concerned cells are compared on the basis of their read access time, write access time, retention time and power dissipation. All design and simulation work has been performed on Tanner EDA tool.

articleTitle: R — Peak detection using Bayesian regularization neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This paper gives a new approach for a automatically detect the R peaks of ECG signal, for which R peaks detection baseline wonder is removed to minimize the noise interference. We use Kaiser Windowing technique and automated Bayesian regularization neural network to learn the characteristics of QRS complex to detect R peaks. This algorithm detection performance is high with the sensitivity is 98.6% and positive Predictivity 98.64%.

articleTitle: A new sorting approach for big data set: Hit sort
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: In this paper we are going to introduce a completely new sorting algorithm that is the hit sort(sorting by counting). Thus mathematically sorting means to sort the big data sets in less time and less memory space. Hit sort actually sorts the entire array in n square amount of time complexity. So we would we analyzing this algorithm and compare it with the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and performance analysis of siloxanne based single mode optical fiber for designated wavelength windows
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: The paper focuses on the designing, characterization and performance analysis of the designed single mode polymer optical waveguide at SOI compatible wavelengths or compatible wavelength windows. The characteristics of the Silicon polymer, SILOXANNE, are calculated by taking IEEE standards as the benchmark. The waveguide was designed in the form of an optical fiber whose core's width is 4.15 micro-meter and cladding's width is 58.35 micro-meter. The wavelengths for which the fiber is tested are 1310 nm and 1550 nm. Propagation losses, cutoff and dispersion loss are calculated. The core's and cladding's refractive index being 1.507 and 1.491 respectively. Propagation losses calculated for 1310 nm and 1550 nm are 0.32 dB/km and 0.19 dB/km respectively.

articleTitle: A result analysis of pilot assisted channel estimation in MIMO-STBC systems over time-varying fading channels
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: An analysis on numerous researches on MIMO STBC system so as to achieve the higher system performance is standard that the performance of the wireless communication systems can be enhanced by utilization multiple transmit and receive antennas (MIMO), that is typically supposed because the MIMO technique, and has been included. The reference system cryptography (STBC) may be a promising thanks to notice the gain within the wireless communications system exploitation MIMO. To extend the code rate and also the output of the orthogonal area time block code for over 2 transmit antennas is analyzed. The designed system is outperformed once imposed with 16-PSK modulation. The system organized and tested for 4×M and 2×M, wherever M is variety of receiver antennas.

articleTitle: Noise removal for unconstrained iris recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: VW iris images are highly noisy unconstrained iris images illuminated in VW light. This paper presents removing noise from the VW iris images. In respect of iris recognition noise may be due reflection of light, hairs and eyelids portion. Here, in terms VW images we have experimented UBIRIS.v2 VW images which are considered highly noisy in VW databases. After removing there three noisy artifacts from VW iris images results of iris recognition will be improved.

articleTitle: An intelligent eNodeB for lte uplink based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: The use of Levenberg Marquardt (LM) and gradient descent (GD) based machine learning algorithms in feed forward random neural network (RNN) for preparing calculation based structure is utilized to enhance radio resource management (RRM) and inter cell interference coordination (ICIC) in LTE framework. In this paper neural system dependent cognitive engine is implanted inside eNodeB which coordinately propose ideal radio factor to the clients, and optimum transmit energy to the working clients by neighboring cells. Less computational complexity, quick decision making, and long term learning are fundamental necessities to outline to convey methodically in any cognitive communication framework and the greater part of the existing strategies utilized as a cognitive method need in. The phenomenon of feed forward RNN upheld structure is inspected with conventional methods. To guarantee a superior execution of the framework, the outcomes are checked and contrasted with conventional methods.

articleTitle: An intelligent text editor for hindi based on micro-parsing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: The use of Hindi on Internet has increased manyfold. Though the Hindi material is available in digital form, still practically no work has been done to detect and correct structurally wrong Hindi words. This paper present a tool that capable of detecting structurally wrong Hindi words based on Micro-Parsing. The tool also corrects such words.

articleTitle: Enhancement of voltage security by MW-generation rescheduling based on sensitivities using black hole
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This paper presents a new methodology for improving voltage stability under stressed condition by active power rescheduling accounting inequality constraints. Whenever the reactive power control variables are exhausted, then only active power control variables are used to enhance the voltage profile as well as to obtain desired voltage stability margin. MW-generation rescheduling using the algorithm increases considerable voltage security margin and load bus voltage as well. The objective is to optimize minimum eigenvalue of load flow Jacobian which indicates the proximity indicator of present operating point to saddle node bifurcation point. The minimum eigenvalue of load flow Jacobian has been optimized using Black Hole (BH) algorithm. Proposed methodology has been implemented on IEEE 14-bus test system. Performance of the developed algorithm are compared based on statistical inference of the fitness function with, Teaching Learning Based Optimization (TLBO) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) techniques. The simulation results are good enough to accept and validate the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Metal metalloid thin film for the application of field effect transistor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: Metal Selenium thin film prepared as Metal Semiconductor Field Effect Thin film Transistor. Metal (Al/Cu) contact and metalloid (Se) channel used as a Field Effect Transistor on glass substrate by depositing the source, drain and top-gate Al/Cu contact. Metal gate is used to control flow of charge from source to drain. By varying the width of depletion layer channel has controlled using metal contact which modulates the thickness of conducting channel which causes flow of current between source and drain. The source and drain of the FET structure were defined by the metal layers Cu were sequentially deposited on the Se in the defined contact patterns by thermal evaporation technique at pressure of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> torr using vacuum coating unit. Its electrical and structural properties were characterized. This device is used to control the flow of current by changeable potential applied between gate and source (VGS), and free charge accumulation has induced at semiconductor interface.

articleTitle: Evaluation of MTCMOS technique with park mode on chain of 2 input CMOS NAND gate
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: The advances in CMOS technology has contributed largely in scaling down the feature size to achieve high density and performance but this results in an increase in the magnitude of both dynamic and static power dissipation. MTCMOS is most efficient technique for power reduction in CMOS circuits. In this work we evaluated performance parameters of MTCMOS with park mode of operation. For evaluation of MTCMOS with park mode here we consider digital universal logic gate (NAND gate) and the parameters like wakeup time, ground bouncing, and supply bouncing noise, static power dissipation, dynamic power dissipation and delay are considered. All the circuits are simulated using Tanner EDA tool.

articleTitle: Design of a CMOS signal processing system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Information, Communication, Instrumentation and Control (ICICIC)
abstract: This paper presents a design of CMOS signal processing system, which consists of two choppers, a differential difference amplifier, a two-stage amplifier, an anti aliasing filter and a switched capacitor filter can be used to process the signal comes from Micro-Electro-Mechanical System (MEMS) sensors. This processing system is basically designed for Respiratory system to process the low frequency signal through choppers, amplifiers and filters.
